sources.title: GitHub - k2-fsa/icefall
sources.snippet: The icefall project contains speech-related recipes for various datasets using k2-fsa and lhotse. You can use sherpa, sherpa-ncnn or sherpa-onnx for deployment with models in icefall; these frameworks also support models not included in icefall; please refer to respective documents for more details.

sources.snippet: Summary: This PR adds a visual speech recognition (VSR) recipe for the GRID corpus using an unseen speaker evaluation setup. The pipeline covers data preparation, feature extraction, training, and decoding. sources.title: k2-fsa/icefall | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Icefall is a collection of speech-related recipes that implement state-of-the-art Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems using k2-fsa and lhotse This repository provides the glue between flexible data manipulation (Lhotse), differentiable FST operations (k2), and deep learning architectures (PyTorch).
